headline: $52,507.63 approved to restore Law Department spending for November
summary: The mayor asked for money to restore ordinary Law Department spending for November and for legal services tied to the November 4, 2026 election. The request was approved by a vote of six, with one member absent. The administration committed to a progress update on quotes for an outside audit of legal spending by December 1.
decisions: Approved a $52,507.63 supplemental appropriation for the fiscal 2027 Law Department budget, 6 yes with 1 absent.
discussion: Law Department funding: Members discussed an outside audit of legal spending. The administration was to seek quotes from five suggested organizations and report progress.
Outside audit: Members said an independent review was needed to answer questions about legal spending after months of back and forth with the administration.
City solicitor position: Members said the city solicitor position should be posted as part of the same process.

decision_evidence.quote: Motion to approve. On the motion approved by Councillor Leming, seconded by Councillor Malauulu. Clerk Siegel, please call the roll....Yes, six the affirmative one absent the motion passes.

decision_titles: $52,507.63 supplemental appropriation for fiscal 2027 Law Department budget
